Sheela Chandrashekar Associate Professor and Head of Department – BCAB.Sc (Computer Science, Kuvempu University), M.Sc (Computer Science, Kuvempu University), Ph.D. (Jain University) Linkedin Link Dr. R. Sheela currently serves as the Head of the BCA Department with a passion for teaching and has progressive teaching experience of over 17 years in Computer Science and IT. Her expertise extends to Cyber Security, Forensic Computing, Digital Forensics, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Incident Handling, Image Processing and Periocular Face Recognition. To her credit, she has a paper published in SCI-indexed journals at King Saud University, has contributed a book chapter to IGI Global Publications and has published five Scopus-indexed papers. Specialisations and Interests Cyber Security, Cyber Forensics, Face Recognition Publications and Career Highlights Authored the book titled Digital Revolution in India: Cybersecurity Essentials for Digital Age Sheela R, Suchithra R.
